cues: A titration is only as good as the solution you claim to know.
A primary standard is so pure and stable that you can make a standard solution just by weighing it accurately and dissolving it to a known volume.
A secondary standard cannot be trusted on the balance.
Its concentration must be found by titrating it against a primary standard.

A primary standard is so pure and stable that you can make a standard solution just by weighing it accurately and dissolving it to a known volume. A secondary standard cannot be trusted on the balance. Its concentration must be found by titrating it against a primary standard.
